mu_uniform_plus_slant.msg: PMM2DStackPure.add_layer: slant= together with mu / mu_cell is not implemented -- a SLANTED layer runs the OUT-OF-PLANE first-order generator, which carries no permeability blocks (it eliminates G3 assuming mu = 1).  The shear's own metric anisotropy is absorbed analytically; a MATERIAL mu is not.  Drop mu, or z-staircase the slanted magnetic layer.

Solve without retain_internal, or z-staircase the slanted layer.
